coverage_gaps: Independent tests that try to prove or disprove whether Sora-class models are true physics simulators are still scarce.
Few apples-to-apples comparisons of pretty video quality versus success when an agent actually plans with the model.
Robotics transfer from foundation video world models into the real world is thinner than the demo videos suggest.
suggested_next_queries: video world model action conditioning physics consistency benchmark
Sora world simulator critique counterfactual planning evaluation
sim-to-real robotics generative video world foundation model

materials.relevance_rationale: Canonical modern world-model RL agent: generation is for imagined planning, not media.
materials.short_description: DreamerV3 learns environment dynamics and improves behavior by imagining futures across many domains. Best academic starting point for the simulator-for-control side of this debate.
key_claims: A single world-model agent can master diverse domains
Planning in latent imagination is practical at scale
materials.limitations: Latent dynamics rather than Sora-scale RGB video.

materials.relevance_rationale: Flagship interactive generative environment — simulator framing made explicit.
materials.short_description: Genie learns action-controllable virtual worlds from unlabeled videos. Widely cited when distinguishing interactive world models from one-shot generative media.
key_claims: Latent actions can be learned without ground-truth controls
Generative models can yield interactive environments
materials.limitations: Playable domains remain constrained versus photoreal foundation video.

materials.relevance_rationale: Uses text-guided video generation as the planning representation.
materials.short_description: UniPi treats decision making as generating a video plan from text, then reading actions from frames — a core bridge between generative video and planning.
key_claims: Video models can propose multi-step plans from language
Action extraction closes the loop to control
materials.limitations: Scale lags frontier media models; limited evaluation domains.

materials.relevance_rationale: Links diffusion visual fidelity to planning-relevant imagination.
materials.short_description: DIAMOND uses diffusion world modeling for Atari and argues visual detail in imagined rollouts matters for control.
key_claims: Diffusion world models can be competitive for RL imagination
Discarding visual detail can hurt imagined-policy learning
materials.limitations: Atari-scale results may not extrapolate to real-world physics.

materials.relevance_rationale: Industry world model in autonomous driving where planning stakes are real.
materials.short_description: Wayve's GAIA-1 generates driving futures conditioned on video, text, and action — world-model video for scenario simulation, not entertainment.
key_claims: Action-conditioned video supports driving scenario synthesis
Multimodal conditioning enables controllable futures
materials.limitations: Proprietary driving-data regime.

materials.relevance_rationale: Industry platform pitching world foundation models for Physical AI.
materials.short_description: NVIDIA Cosmos frames world foundation models as infrastructure for embodied/Physical AI simulation workflows.
key_claims: World foundation models as transferable simulation priors
Physical AI needs more than media-generation APIs
materials.limitations: Platform paper; read independent closed-loop benchmarks carefully.

materials.relevance_rationale: Primary industry claim that Sora-class video models are world simulators.
materials.short_description: OpenAI's public technical note arguing video generation models are progressing toward general-purpose world simulators — the industry claim this dossier interrogates.
key_claims: Scaling video generation yields more coherent world dynamics
Simulators are framed as an aspirational capability of media models
materials.limitations: Not a peer-reviewed empirical study; treat as a position/tech note.

materials.relevance_rationale: Stress test of generative dynamics as a real-time interactive engine.
materials.short_description: GameNGen demonstrates real-time interactive simulation of DOOM with a diffusion model — evidence for the simulator thesis under interactivity constraints.
key_claims: Neural simulators can run complex interactive environments in real time
Game engines are a proving ground for world-model fidelity
materials.limitations: Game physics is not real-world Physical AI.

materials.relevance_rationale: High-quality video generation baseline for the media-model pole.
materials.short_description: VideoPoet showcases strong zero-shot video generation. Use as the generative-media reference when asking what extra structure a world simulator needs.
key_claims: LLM-style architectures can generate coherent video zero-shot
Media quality is the primary optimization target
materials.limitations: Not designed or evaluated as a planner/world model.

materials.relevance_rationale: Thesis-track depth on efficient RL policy optimization adjacent to world-model control.
materials.short_description: PhD thesis on trust-region policy optimization for sample-efficient reinforcement learning — useful dissertation-format background for control learning methods.
key_claims: Trust-region methods improve stability of policy updates
Sample efficiency remains central for practical control learning
materials.limitations: Not specifically about video generation as a simulator.
